Test Automation Lead skill -- Use when building and maintaining test automation -- frameworks, CI integration, test data management, and flaky test resolution.
Test Case Generator skill -- Use when generating test cases from requirements including positive, negative, edge, boundary, and error-handling scenarios.
Test Data Manager skill -- Use when managing test data -- creating fixtures, factories, seed scripts, and ensuring data isolation across test runs.
Test Engineer skill -- Use when designing test strategies, generating test cases, executing test suites, and reporting test results with coverage metrics.
Test Environment Manager skill -- Use when managing test environments -- provisioning, data seeding, health monitoring, and cleanup.
Test Executor skill -- Use when executing test suites, collecting pass/fail results, identifying flaky tests, and generating execution logs.
Test Plan Generator skill -- Use when generating targeted test plans covering areas affected by the upgrade including regression, compatibility, and performance tests.
Test Reporter skill -- Use when generating test reports with coverage metrics, pass/fail rates, defect analytics, and quality gate go/no-go recommendations.
Test Strategist skill -- Use when designing risk-based test strategies, analyzing coverage gaps, planning environments, and designing test data.
Test Suite Runner skill -- Use when executing full test suite after upgrade to verify no regressions.
Unit Test Generator skill -- Use when generating unit tests with positive, negative, and edge case scenarios targeting 80%+ line coverage.
Unit Test Writer skill -- Use when writing unit tests for new feature code including happy path, edge cases, error handling, and achieving coverage targets.
Unit Tester skill -- Write and execute unit tests with mocking, assertions, and coverage measurement.
Upgrade Tester skill -- Use when testing upgrades -- compatibility testing, regression testing, performance comparison, and rollback verification.
